Reviewed the logs from the customer (tabprotosrv.txt and the HAR file). Found SAML error: AudienceRestriction mismatch - the SP entity ID in Okta does not match Tableau Server after the certificate rotation. Tested in lab with Okta dev tenant and reproduced the same error by changing the audience URI.
